correctness.rationale: The ordered composition generating series F(z)=1/(1-S), S=Σ_j z^{2^j}, T=Σ_{i<j}z^{2^i+2^j} obeys S(1-S)=z-2T, hence exact integral F=(S/z)(1-2T/z)^(-1). Modulo 2^N, a potentially surviving summand at r<N in Σ_r 2^r z^{-r-1}ST^r shows n+r+1 is a sum of exactly 2r+1 powers of two, so s2(n+r+1)<=2r+1. Since n+N=(n+r+1)+(N-r-1), digit-weight subadditivity gives s2(n+N)<=N+r<=2N-1. Contrapositive proves for all N>=1 and n>=0: s2(n+N)>=2N implies 2^N|theta(n). Translation to [0,2^K) counts at most Σ_{j<=2N-1}binom(K+1,j) exceptional indices (for 2^K>=N), so O_N((log x)^(2N-1)). Independently checked recurrence mod1024 through n<250000: FIVE_BINARY_COMPOSITION_PASS. Universal validity comes from formal series, not the test.
